title: Terrible Towels
text: Terrible Towels. These towels are awful. They are super soft microfiber, but they are not very absorbent. They’re very thin. The edges are bound with bias tape instead of being sewn like a normal towel. They look cheap because of the edge binding. I’m not a fan of these at all.
